name: CANASTA
description: Canasta is a rummy-style partnership card game played with two 52-card decks plus 4 jokers (108 cards). Jokers and 2s are wild. Players form melds of 3+ cards of the same rank. A 'canasta' (meld of 7+ cards) earns powerful bonuses. The game originated in Uruguay in 1939 and became a worldwide phenomenon rivaling Contract Bridge in the 1950s. First partnership to 5000 points wins.

content.text: Canasta is a rummy-style partnership card game played with two 52-card decks plus 4 jokers (108 cards). Jokers and 2s are wild. Players form melds of 3+ cards of the same rank. A 'canasta' (meld of 7+ cards) earns powerful bonuses. The game originated in Uruguay in 1939 and became a worldwide phenomenon rivaling Contract Bridge in the 1950s. First partnership to 5000 points wins.
Created c.1939 by Segundo Santos (lawyer) and Alberto Serrato (architect) at the Jockey Club of Montevideo, Uruguay. 'Canasta' means 'basket' in Spanish (referring to the discard basket).
4 in fixed partnerships (partners sit opposite). Variants for 2, 3, or 6.

items.text: Modern American Canasta: More complex rules, goes-out requirements, and special hands. Dominant in North American clubs.
Samba: 3 decks. Allows sequence melds (same suit runs). Samba = 7-card run bonus. Target 10000 pts.
Hand and Foot: Each player gets 2 sets of cards (the Hand and the Foot). Foot is picked up when Hand is exhausted.
